items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But my favorite one was Ninesh Repanya. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah. Oh, Ninesh played snatter, based on both of them. Ninesh, Ninesh.

ctx.x: I think he was very, very, very good. Yes indeed. But my favorite one was Ninesh Repanya.
Oh yeah. Oh, Ninesh played snatter, based on both of them. Ninesh, Ninesh.
He'd be right out to Peter and talk to him.
